description: Needs enableSupervisedControl. Settle a supervised action whose outcome is pending or uncertain: reads the game again (the block, the world joined or left, the finished input sample) and reports the outcome. While any action is open, no other supervised action runs. If the outcome cannot be read back (a command), pass acknowledge: true to accept that it is unknown.

acknowledge.description: Close the action as acknowledged when the readback cannot settle it.

actionId.description: The actionId of the open action, e.g. "a3".

name: supervised_reconcile
title: Reconcile a supervised action
